top_signals.title: Canadian Dollar Gains Most Since August on BOC Inflation Warning
top_signals.summary: The Canadian dollar is headed for its biggest gain in more than three months after the head of the Bank of Canada warned higher oil costs will further drive up consumer prices, compounding persistent inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Ukraine Strikes Russian Ship in Gulf of Finland
top_signals.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy confirmed his country was responsible for Saturday's drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland, while Norway, a strong supporter of Kyiv, urged it to exercise caution in such operations.Finnish…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
top_signals.summary: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
